notes.title: The mighty patch is here!
notes.notes:
The latest such update is now available. 

What changes have been made? About that below!


 New side plot thread "John Dee"
 Nine hidden puzzle side quests
 Additional unique items, monsters and bosses
 Ready-made, larger item sets at merchants (ammo, food, potions, etc.)
 Rework of reward system and character class development (active from the new game)
 Rebalance of damage, life points, special skills and falling items.
 Rework of the game difficulty level system (decreasing the difficulty for players on "EASY" level, making the game more difficult in "DIFFICULT" mode and making it much harder in "NIGHTMARE" mode)  
 Rework of the in-game price balance (global reduction of item values)
 Improved immunity modifier panel
 Hundreds of new monster spawners (across the map and various stages of the game)
 Optimisation of existing monster zones
 Improved final location of the main storyline
 Icons for active quests/trades/dialogs at selected NPCs
 Names of game world regions
 New menu sound and improved combat and movement sounds
 Story subtitles for cutscenes
 New player tips in tutorial dialogue 
 Improved display of modifiers in item descriptions 
 New font

Day One Patch

notes.notes:
The future is today!
The long-awaited moment has arrived. After many months of product development, we have reached the stage where we can say to ourselves that we are ready to click the "Publish" button. Over the past two months, we have added a fair amount of new mechanics to the game. 

That's not the end of it though
Immediately after the release, we will present you with a schedule of patching and development of the game. Our goal is for M.E.A.T. to receive as many new features as possible, which will then become the foundation for the MMORPG release. For this reason, keep an eye on the Steam Community Center, as this is where we will be posting all relevant information.

M.E.A.T. will launch at...
... 21:30 - although we ask for your possible forbearance as this is our first launch and the time may still change.

notes.title: Let it snow, let it snow... OPEN BETA English language version update
notes.notes:
Ho ho ho!

The latest update of open M.E.A.T. tests is now available:

 Sir Culligan's Christmas skin in Santa's version;
 more quests;
 English language version of the game (please note that the English language version will work only if your operating system language version is not Polish)
 fix some of the bugs reported to us (all updated according to our priority list, where "fatal error" is always in the first place);


As always - we ask you to report any bugs in our STEAM forum. Your feedback allows us to improve the game significantly with each subsequent update. You are an invaluable support and as always, we encourage you to take screenshots or share your opinion on the development of the game.

How to become a tester?
If you want to join the group of testers, please send an e-mail to the address: kontakt@meatrpg.com, by adding "TESTING THE GAME" in the message title, and you will receive a special Steam access code.

Remember one thing though...

...after the end of open BETA tests, the key you received will be automatically deactivated and access to the game will only be possible if you purchase a full version.

notes.title: Let's play M.E.A.T. on Valentine's Day - date of game release
notes.notes:
h1]Fall in love with M.E.A.T.!

Hello!

Because of the many variables, we have to announce a new official date for the release of the game. While we have already implemented most of the mechanics, our ambition does not allow us to release a product that will not pass a robust QA (Quality Assurance) process.

Why are you postponing the game release date until February?

From our calculations, it appears that releasing the game according to our vision and assumptions will be possible in February. However, Valentine's Day is the ideal moment for Cupid to use his bow and make you love what we have prepared for you!

We, therefore, had to make a tough but necessary decision - you will already be playing this Valentine's Day, February 14th, 2021, in a fully-fledged version of M.E.A.T.!

What are you going to do for the next few months?

We want to give the first submissión of the game to be assessed by Steam in January to see what exactly we need to improve. With this, we also want to leave the beta tests open until the end of January. After that, a selected group will be able to join the closed tests of the final version of the game  (playing from start to finish). We will publish more information about this after Christmas.

How to become a tester?

If you want to join the testers group, send an email to: kontakt@meatrpg.com, adding 'TESTING THE GAME' in the message title and you will receive a special access code for Steam.

Remember one thing, however...

...after the completion of open BETA tests, the key you received will be automatically deactivated and access to the game will only be possible if you purchase a full version.

notes.title: English version of OPEN BETA is coming!
notes.notes:
It's time for a cup of tea!

M.E.A.T. Lovers, the telastarion rulers!

Here comes the moment that many of you have been waiting for - access to the English language version of our open BETA tests! This Friday, December 18th, 2020, you will have the pleasure of choosing the most suitable language version of M.E.A.T.! You can choose between Polish and... English!

This update is addressed in particular to people who were interested in testing our game and could not take full advantage of the benefits provided by open BETA tests. Therefore, we hope that from now on no language barrier will prevent you from discovering the corners of the mysterious world of Washagami!

How to become a tester?
If you want to join the group of testers, please send an e-mail to the address: kontakt@meatrpg.com, by adding "GAME TESTING" in the title of the message, and you will receive a special Steam access code.

Remember one thing, however...
...after the end of open BETA tests, the key you received will be automatically deactivated and access to the game will only be possible if you purchase a full version.

notes.title: Update of M.E.A.T. OPEN BETA TEST!
notes.notes:
Launch newest update of M.E.A.T. OPEN BETA TEST

Dear M.E.A.T. Lovers, Sir Culligan's adventurers!

As promised, it is already possible to download the update of the M.E.A.T. OPEN BETA TEST:

 a trading system with NPCs encountered during your journey;
 the first quests exploring the M.E.A.T. storyline;
 fixing most of the bugs you have submitted;
 improved mob selecting mechanics;
 selecting a mob using the keyboard button (currently it is the "E" button). 

Is this the end of open tests? Nothing could be further from the truth! We are constantly working to provide you with new content and mechanics in the framework of OPEN BETA, which will give you a full picture of what M.E.A.T. is supposed to be. 

So take your revolvers out of the holster, put on hats, wear comfortable waistcoats, and collect all the necessary items - the M.E.A.T. OPEN BETA 2.0 has just started!

How to become a tester?

If you want to join the tester group, please send an e-mail to the address: kontakt@meatrpg.com, adding 'GAME TESTING' in the message title, and you will receive a special Steam access code.

Remember one thing, however...

...once the open BETA tests have been completed, the key you have received will be automatically deactivated and access to the game will only be possible if a full version is purchased by you.
